_about: Session programs, warm-up and stretch lists, and the swap system. Each exercise line in the app is stored as "name|scheme|cue"; here it is split. scheme reads like "3 × 8-10" or "3 × 30 s / side". A swap replaces an exercise with another from the same muscle-group pool and the same kit; slot_of maps an exercise to its pool; pools[slot][kit] lists the alternatives for that kit (name, cue, muscles). The swapped-in exercise inherits the session's sets and reps.

exercises.name: Chair sit-to-stand (DBs at chest when easy)
exercises.cue: Feet flat and hip-width, just in front of the chair. Stand by pushing the floor away; sit back down slowly instead of dropping. Don't rock forward to build momentum — chest up, let the legs do it.

exercises.name: Band seated row, anchored at chest height
exercises.cue: Loop the band around a table leg at chest height and sit tall on a chair. Pull your elbows back past your ribs and squeeze the shoulder blades together. Keep the shoulders down — if they creep toward your ears, the band is too heavy.

exercises.name: Incline push-up, hands on a kitchen counter
exercises.cue: Hands slightly wider than your shoulders on the counter edge, body in one straight line from head to heels. Lower your chest to the counter, press away. The higher the surface, the easier — start high and lower it over the weeks.

exercises.name: DB Romanian deadlift, 3 s lowering
exercises.cue: Dumbbells in front of your thighs, knees softly bent and fixed. Push your hips backward, let the weights slide down your legs, stop when your hamstrings pull. Your back stays flat — this is a hip movement, not a bend of the spine.

exercises.name: Band pull-apart
exercises.cue: Band held at shoulder height with straight arms. Pull it apart until it touches your chest, squeezing the shoulder blades. Keep your ribs down and don't arch your lower back to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Standing Pallof press, band at chest height
exercises.cue: Stand side-on to the anchor with the band at your chest, feet hip-width. Press the band straight out and resist its pull to rotate you. Nothing moves but your arms — the work is in not twisting.

exercises.name: Split squat, hand on chair
exercises.cue: One foot forward, one back, about two shoe-lengths apart, hand resting on a chair for balance. Drop the back knee straight down, then drive through the front heel. Keep your torso upright — leaning forward turns it into a different exercise.

exercises.name: Band lat pulldown, high door anchor
exercises.cue: Anchor the band above a closed door, kneel or sit facing it. Pull your elbows down toward your ribs, not your hands toward your waist. Lead with the elbows and you will feel it in your back rather than your arms.

exercises.name: Seated DB shoulder press
exercises.cue: Sit upright with back support, dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward. Press up until your arms are nearly straight, lower under control. Don't let your lower back arch off the chair to finish the press.

exercises.name: Low-step step-up, hand on a chair
exercises.cue: A step no higher than your knee, hand on a chair. Put the whole foot on the step and push through that heel to stand — the back leg only helps you balance. Step down slowly rather than dropping.

exercises.name: DB hammer curl
exercises.cue: Dumbbells at your sides, palms facing each other, elbows tucked against your ribs. Curl up without swinging your torso. If your body moves to start the rep, the weight is too heavy.

exercises.name: Band triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Band anchored high, elbows pinned to your sides. Straighten the arms fully, then let them bend back slowly. Only the forearms move — the upper arms stay still.

exercises.name: Suitcase hold, one DB at your side
exercises.cue: Hold one dumbbell at one side, stand tall, and resist leaning toward it. Shoulders level, ribs down. The side without the weight is the one doing the work.

exercises.name: Chair squat
exercises.cue: Sit back to a chair, touch it lightly, stand tall. Push the floor away and keep your knees in line with your toes.

exercises.name: Incline push-up, hands on a counter
exercises.cue: Body in one straight line, lower your chest to the edge, press away. Higher surface is easier.

exercises.name: Reverse lunge, hand on a chair
exercises.cue: Step back, lower the back knee toward the floor, drive up through the front heel.

exercises.name: Towel row on a door handle
exercises.cue: Loop a towel round a sturdy handle, lean back with straight arms, pull your chest to it.

exercises.name: Wall sit
exercises.cue: Back flat on the wall, thighs as low as is comfortable, knees over ankles.

exercises.name: Standing march with arm drive
exercises.cue: Lift the knees to hip height, drive the arms, stay tall.

exercises.name: Split squat, hand on chair
exercises.cue: One foot forward, one back. Drop the back knee straight down, drive through the front heel.

exercises.name: Wall push-up
exercises.cue: Hands on the wall at shoulder height, body straight, chest to the wall and back. Step further out to make it harder.

exercises.name: Single-leg RDL, hand on chair
exercises.cue: Hinge at the hip with a flat back, reach down, stand by squeezing the glute.

exercises.name: Doorway isometric row hold
exercises.cue: Hold the door frame, lean back, pull your shoulder blades together and hold.

exercises.name: Calf raise on a step
exercises.cue: Heels off the edge, rise up high, lower slowly below the step.

exercises.name: Standing knee-to-elbow crunch
exercises.cue: Bring the knee up and across to the opposite elbow, tall between reps.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Feet mid-platform, hip-width. Lower until your knees reach about 90° or your lower back starts to round off the pad, whichever comes first. Never lock the knees hard at the top.

exercises.name: Chest press machine
exercises.cue: Set the seat so the handles sit level with mid-chest. Press away without locking out hard, and control the return. Keep the shoulder blades pinned back into the pad.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Chest tall, slight forward lean at the start. Pull the handle to your belly, elbows past your ribs, squeeze. Don't rock backward to move the weight.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.cue: Pad just above the heels, thighs strapped down. Curl fully, then lower slowly — the lowering is where hamstrings grow. Keep your hips on the seat.

exercises.name: DB lateral raise
exercises.cue: Light dumbbells, slight elbow bend, raise out to the sides only to shoulder height. Lead with the elbows, not the hands. If you have to swing, halve the weight.

exercises.name: Incline plank, hands on a bench
exercises.cue: Hands on a bench, body in one line, squeeze the glutes and tuck the ribs down. Hips neither sagging nor piked up. Breathe normally throughout.

exercises.name: Goblet squat to box
exercises.cue: Hold one dumbbell at your chest, stand in front of a bench. Sit back until you touch it lightly, then stand. The dumbbell at the chest is what lets you stay upright.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Thighs under the pads, slight backward lean, bar to your upper chest. Drive the elbows down toward your ribs. Don't lean back further to finish the rep.

exercises.name: Incline DB press
exercises.cue: Bench at about 30°, dumbbells at chest level, elbows about 45° from your body. Press up and slightly together, lower under control until you feel a stretch.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades on a bench, feet flat and shins vertical at the top. Drive through the heels, squeeze the glutes hard, keep the ribs down. Stop at hips level with knees — don't overarch.

exercises.name: Rope triceps pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned to your sides, push the rope down and slightly apart at the bottom. Only the forearms move.

exercises.name: Standing Pallof press
exercises.cue: Side-on to the cable at chest height, feet hip-width. Press straight out and resist the rotation. Nothing moves but your arms.

exercises.name: Leg press
exercises.cue: Feet mid-platform, hip-width. Lower to about 90° at the knee or until the lower back lifts off the pad. Push through the whole foot, not the toes.

exercises.name: DB Romanian deadlift
exercises.cue: Knees softly bent and fixed, push the hips back, weights sliding down the thighs. Stop at the hamstring stretch. Flat back throughout.

exercises.name: Seated leg curl
exercises.cue: Full curl, slow return. Hips stay down on the seat — lifting them is your hamstrings asking for less weight.

exercises.name: Leg extension
exercises.cue: Pad on the lower shin, straighten fully, pause a beat, lower slowly. Stop if it pinches the front of the knee.

exercises.name: Standing calf raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch at the bottom, full squeeze at the top, no bouncing. One second up, two seconds down.

exercises.name: Chest press machine
exercises.cue: Handles at mid-chest height, shoulder blades pinned back. Press without locking out hard, return under control.

exercises.name: Seated cable row
exercises.cue: Chest tall, pull to the belly, elbows past the ribs. No rocking.

exercises.name: Shoulder press machine
exercises.cue: Handles at shoulder height, press overhead without arching your lower back off the pad. Ribs stay down.

exercises.name: Lat pulldown
exercises.cue: Bar to the upper chest, elbows driving down toward the ribs. Slight lean back, held constant.

exercises.name: DB curl
exercises.cue: Elbows at your sides, no swinging. Lower slower than you lift.

exercises.name: Rope pushdown
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned, forearms only. Push down and slightly apart at the bottom.

exercises.name: Hip thrust
exercises.cue: Shoulder blades on the bench, shins vertical at the top, drive through the heels. Squeeze the glutes, keep the ribs down, stop at hips level with knees.

exercises.name: Hack squat or goblet squat to box
exercises.cue: Feet mid-platform, descend under control to about 90°, drive up through the heels. Keep the lower back flat against the pad.

exercises.name: Lying leg curl
exercises.cue: Hips pressed into the pad, curl fully, lower slowly. Don't let the hips rise to help.

exercises.name: Low-box step-up with DBs
exercises.cue: Box at or below knee height. Whole foot on the box, push through that heel, step down slowly. The back leg is for balance, not for pushing.

exercises.name: Seated calf raise
exercises.cue: Full stretch, full squeeze, no bouncing. This one targets the deeper calf muscle, so slow it down.

exercises.name: Incline DB press
exercises.cue: Bench at 30°, elbows about 45° from the body, press up and slightly together. Control the lowering to a chest stretch.

exercises.name: Chest-supported DB row
exercises.cue: Chest on the incline bench so your lower back is out of it. Pull the elbows past your ribs and squeeze. No jerking.

exercises.name: Cable lateral raise
exercises.cue: Cable at the low setting, slight elbow bend, raise to shoulder height only. Light weight, lead with the elbow.

exercises.name: Face pull
exercises.cue: Rope at upper-chest height, pull toward your forehead with elbows high and wide, rotating the hands back. This is the antidote to a desk job.

exercises.name: Hammer curl
exercises.cue: Palms facing each other, elbows tucked, no torso swing.

exercises.name: Overhead cable extension
exercises.cue: Facing away from the cable, elbows beside your ears and fixed. Straighten the arms overhead, lower slowly to a triceps stretch.

warmup.note: Standing and chair only — nothing on the floor. Keep a hand on something solid.

items.name: Wall ankle rocks
items.cue: Hands on the wall, one foot stepped back. Keep that heel glued down and rock your knee forward over the toes. You should feel it in the calf, not the front of the ankle.

items.name: Standing knee circles, hand on a chair
items.cue: Hand on a chair back, lift one knee toward hip height and draw slow circles outward. Stand tall — don't lean away from the working leg.

items.name: Wall slides, back and arms against the wall
items.cue: Back against the wall, arms in a goalpost with the backs of the hands touching the wall. Slide them up and down while keeping contact. If the hands lift off, only go as high as they stay.

items.name: Standing torso rotations, arms crossed
items.cue: Feet planted, arms crossed over the chest. Rotate your ribcage side to side and let the hips stay still. Smooth and controlled, no ballistic twisting.

items.name: Slow chair sit-to-stand
items.cue: Same movement as the exercise but empty-handed and deliberately slow. This is a rehearsal, not a set — stop well short of tired.

stretch.note: If your torso blocks the fold, shorten the range and hold longer. Never force it against your own body mass.

items.name: Doorway chest stretch, forearm on the frame
items.cue: Forearm flat on the door frame, elbow at shoulder height. Step through with the same-side foot and turn your chest away. Stop at a stretch, never a pinch in the shoulder.

items.name: Standing hip flexor, hands on a counter, tailbone tucked
items.cue: Split stance, hands on the counter, back leg straight. Squeeze that back glute and tuck your tailbone under — the tuck is the whole stretch. Don't lunge deeper to feel more.

items.name: Seated figure-4 glute stretch on a chair
items.cue: Sit on a chair, ankle across the opposite knee. Sit tall and hinge forward from the hips. If your belly blocks the fold, skip the lean and press the raised knee down instead.

items.name: Standing hamstring, heel on a low step, hinge at the hips
items.cue: Heel on a low step, leg straight, chest tall. Push your hips backward rather than rounding down toward the foot. A flat back with a small range beats a rounded back with a big one.

items.name: Wall calf stretch, back leg straight, heel down
items.cue: Hands on the wall, one leg back with the knee straight and the heel pressed down. Keep that back foot pointing forward, not turned out.

items.name: Lat stretch, hands on the counter edge, chest sinking
items.cue: Hands on the counter, step back until your arms are straight, then let your chest sink toward the floor between them. Keep your head between your arms.

items.name: Seated neck side-bend
items.cue: Sit tall, hold the edge of the seat with one hand, tilt your head away from that hand. Gentle — the neck needs far less force than you think.

home.name: Goblet squat to box
home.cue: One DB at the chest, sit back to a chair edge, then stand. Chest stays up.

home.name: Split squat, hand on chair
home.cue: One foot forward, drop the back knee, drive the front heel. Hand on a chair.

home.name: Reverse lunge to a chair
home.cue: Step back, tap the back knee down, drive up. Hold a chair if you need it.

home.name: Bent-over DB row, hand on chair
home.cue: Hinge with a flat back, one hand on a chair, row the DB to the hip.

home.name: Band bent-over row
home.cue: Stand on the band, hinge flat-backed, pull both handles to the ribs.

home.name: Single-arm band row
home.cue: Anchor the band low, pull the elbow back past the ribs, one side at a time.

home.name: Wall push-up
home.cue: Same movement against a wall, the easiest version. Step further out to make it harder.

home.name: Band standing chest press
home.cue: Band behind the back at chest height, press both hands forward and together.

home.name: Knee push-up on a counter
home.cue: Hands on the counter, from the knees, lower the chest and press away.

home.name: DB sumo deadlift
home.cue: Wide stance, one DB between the feet, hinge and stand tall, hips through at the top.

home.name: Band pull-through
home.cue: Band anchored low behind you, hinge, then drive the hips forward against it.

home.name: Single-leg RDL, hand on chair
home.cue: One leg, hinge and reach the DB down with a flat back. Hand on a chair.

home.name: Band face pull
home.cue: Band at face height, pull toward the forehead, elbows high and wide.

home.name: Hinged reverse DB fly
home.cue: Hinge with a flat back, raise light DBs out to the sides, lead with the elbows.

home.name: Band W-pull
home.cue: Band at chest height, pull apart and down into a W, squeezing the blades.

home.name: Suitcase hold
home.cue: Hold one DB at the side, stand tall, do not lean. The empty side does the work.

home.name: Band chop
home.cue: High anchor, pull the band down and across the body, hips still.

home.name: Half-kneeling band hold
home.cue: Kneel side-on, hold the band out at the chest, resist the pull.

home.name: Reverse lunge to a chair
home.cue: Step back, tap the knee, drive up. Hold a chair for balance.

home.name: Low-step step-up
home.cue: Whole foot on a low step, push through that heel, step down slowly.

home.name: Split squat, hand on chair
home.cue: Front heel drives you up, torso upright, hand on a chair.

home.name: Band straight-arm pulldown
home.cue: Arms straight, pull the band down to the thighs from overhead.

home.name: Single-arm band pulldown
home.cue: One arm at a time, drive the elbow down and back.

home.name: Band bent-over row
home.cue: Stand on the band, hinge, pull the handles to the ribs.

home.name: Standing DB press
home.cue: Press the DBs overhead standing, brace the abs, ribs down.

home.name: Band overhead press
home.cue: Stand on the band, press the handles overhead.

home.name: Seated Arnold press
home.cue: Start palms-in, rotate to palms-forward as you press up.

home.name: DB curl
home.cue: Palms up, curl without moving the elbows, slow lowering.

home.name: Band curl
home.cue: Stand on the band, curl both handles, slow return.

home.name: Cross-body hammer curl
home.cue: Palms in, curl each DB across to the opposite shoulder.

home.name: Seated DB overhead extension
home.cue: One DB overhead, lower behind the head, elbows still.

home.name: DB kickback, hand on chair
home.cue: Hinge, upper arm still, straighten the arm back.

home.name: Close-grip push-up on a counter
home.cue: Hands narrow on the counter, elbows brushing the ribs.

home.name: Standing Pallof press
home.cue: Band at the chest, press out, resist the rotation.

home.name: Side plank on a bench
home.cue: Forearm on a bench, body straight, hold. A higher surface is easier.

home.name: Standing band side-bend hold
home.cue: Hold the band at one side, stand tall, resist the pull sideways.
